title: the Green Zone Rising
author: Orsen Montrose
blurb: Jude Zhou, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
